notes.title: Playtest #1 – Mission Accomplished! 🎉
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We're Free Particle Studio — a tiny-but-mighty indie dev team. Just a quick update: after extending twice, our first playtest will officially conclude on June 22, 2025.[/p][p]We’re utterly blown away by your support! Player numbers smashed our expectations, and your feedback has been incredibly valuable (seriously, our Trello board is overflowing!).[/p][p]Next stop: crunching those updates! We’ll be heads-down improving the game, but let’s meet again soon. Until then—keep those Discord memes coming. 🚀[/p][p]🔗 Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p]🔗 QQ Group: 1040049398[/p][p]🔗 Bilibili: [url="https://space.bilibili.com/3546892524849637?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0"]https://space.bilibili.com/3546892524849637?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Free Particle Studio[/p]
